pyqgis_plugin.name: Hugo's Magic Colours
pyqgis_plugin.description: Applies symbology to hydraulic rasters — depth, velocity, water level, hazard, ZAEM1, afflux, SRC, DEM_M, and DEM grids. Also applies transparency (Alt+T+ 0-9 (0-90%) or F (100%)).
pyqgis_plugin.about: Select a raster layer and click the button. The plugin detects the raster type from its filename suffix and applies appropriate symbology automatically.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Stage Storage
pyqgis_plugin.description: Creates stage storage data from shapefile area and DEM.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Creates stage storage data from shapefile area and DEM. Includes additional features such as multi-polygons (without batch process), feature field for ID, and optional base levels.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Mannings Downloader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Downloads Sentinel-2 Land Cover Data and Creates Manning's Roughness suitable for TUFLOW.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Downloads Sentinel-2 Land Cover Data from Esri's Living Atlas and Creates Manning's Roughness suitable for TUFLOW. Optional extra layers from OSM (Buildings, Roads, Creeks etc).
